Package com.privatechain.core.spi

Class ValidationResult

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.core.spi.ValidationResult
public final class ValidationResult extends Object
Immutable result returned by TransactionValidator.validate(com.privatechain.core.model.Transaction, com.privatechain.core.builder.Blockchain).

A result is either successful or failed. On failure, it carries a non-empty list of human-readable error messages and a ValidationResult.ValidationStatus classifying the failure category (FR-TX-02).

Factory methods success(), failure(ValidationStatus, String), and failure(ValidationStatus, List) cover the common construction patterns.


 // In a validator implementation:
 if (!signatureOk) {
     return ValidationResult.failure(
         ValidationStatus.INVALID_SIGNATURE,
         "Signature does not match sender public key");
 }
 return ValidationResult.success();
Since:
1.0.0

      public static ValidationResult success()
      Returns the canonical singleton representing a successful validation.

      a ValidationResult with success=true and ValidationResult.ValidationStatus.VALID

    • failure

      public static ValidationResult failure(ValidationResult.ValidationStatus status, String message)
      Creates a failed result with a single error message.
      Parameters:
      status - classification of the failure (non-null, must not be ValidationResult.ValidationStatus.VALID)
      message - human-readable error description (non-null, non-blank)
      Returns:
      a failed ValidationResult
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if status or message is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if status is ValidationResult.ValidationStatus.VALID or message is blank
